misconceptions.description: Treating a notice that students will use an AI tool as equivalent to obtaining consent
misconceptions.trigger: learner writes that parents were informed or notified and stops there
misconceptions.feedback: Notification is not consent. For minors, require active parental opt-in and student assent on a plain-language screen.

misconceptions.description: Assuming a student clicking agree provides the legal consent required to collect their data
misconceptions.trigger: learner relies on a student check-box and omits the parent or guardian
misconceptions.feedback: Minors give assent, not legal consent. Name both the student assent and the guardian consent in the policy.

misconceptions.description: Allowing a tool to collect student data without naming the purpose, the retention period, or who can access it
misconceptions.trigger: learner approves a tool that personalizes using stored data but never asks what is kept or for how long
misconceptions.feedback: State the specific learning purpose, the retention window, the deletion rule, and whether the vendor may train on the data.
